headline: A 1-for-5 night
record_line: Yesterday: 1-4 on the top plays · Season: 3-17

entries.headline: Esmerlyn Valdez connected at +350
entries.story: Esmerlyn Valdez cashed. Facing Jameson Taillon, he went deep in the 2nd in his 1st at bat. The call: "Esmerlyn Valdez homers (14) on a fly ball to left center field." Final line: 2-for-3 with 1 BB.

entries.headline: Denzer Guzman stayed in the yard
entries.story: Denzer Guzman went 1-for-4 against Carson Whisenhunt and the San Francisco Giants. No real scare on the HR front.

entries.headline: Riley Greene stayed in the yard
entries.story: Riley Greene went 0-for-5 with 1 RBI against Luinder Avila and the Kansas City Royals. No real scare on the HR front.

entries.headline: Bryce Harper came close
entries.story: Bryce Harper went 1-for-4 with 1 BB against Will Warren and the New York Yankees. Closest call was a double in the 3rd: "Bryce Harper doubles (20) on a line drive to right fielder Jasson Domínguez. Kyle Schwarber to 3rd." The power showed up; the carry did not.

entries.headline: A.J. Ewing came close
entries.story: A.J. Ewing went 1-for-3 with 2 BB against Emmet Sheehan and the Los Angeles Dodgers. Closest call was a double in the 1st: "A.J. Ewing doubles (12) on a fly ball to right fielder Kyle Tucker, deflected by center fielder Andy Pages." The power showed up; the carry did not.
